name: corepos-desktop
description: CorePOS - offline point of sale for retail shops

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare:php:win && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32
scripts.dist:win:mac: npm run prepare:php:win && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prepare:php:mac && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal
scripts.dist:all: npm run prepare:php:win && npm run prepare:php:win7 && npm run prepare:php:mac && npm run prepare:php:linux && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --mac dmg --universal && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --config build/legacy.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --config build/legacy.config.cjs --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:win7: npm run prepare:php:win7 && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config build/legacy.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && electron-builder --config build/legacy.config.cjs --win nsis --ia32 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prepare:php:linux && npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --arm64

linux.synopsis: Offline point of sale for shops
linux.description: CorePOS - offline point of sale for shops and restaurants. Your data stays on this computer.
